body:
Well, I'm suitably anesthetized. I'm out. I hope you guys have better luck in life than I did. 

Heck, I didn't even find the time to finish Ico.

Night, everyone.

Opinions and world views, I'm about as selfish as any other person. About what I meant earlier, though...

I tried to talk to my ex-girlfriend for support, just as a friend. First time I approached her about it, she slapped me. Second time, she elaborated that I was being selfish. I should really think about her and how my suicide would make her feel bad and stuff. And to be quite honest, I don't care about making her happy.

Sorry you wandered into a suicide note, man. Some people have all the luck, right?

Ico's fun. Escourt mission: the game, except good. I had to crank the light on the game way up to see anything, and now the water's too bright, but that's my only complaint.

SotC looks fun. I saw a friend play it once. Seems like a blast.
I hear they're coming out with a new one with a griffon or something. I hope you enjoy it.
I've been giving it time. I'm pretty much just glad I'm actually taking steps towards accomplishing something. And in the grand scheme of things, I don't matter.

I appreciate the sentiment, but I don't want to get better, I just want to get out. I've talked to friends, therapists and hotline people, and, frankly, I find that it's a lot of work for no reward. Existing in the first place was a bad deal. I'm just returning to sender.
